title: Analyze or execute a repository import
description: Inspect an immutable source commit and reconcile it with a Megamono host before any history graft.

monorepo.description: Opt-in reviewed multi-project import. Every static source project root must be mapped to import (name, optional packageName, complete configuration) or reuse (host project). Requires subtree and verify=build.

source.description: Local Git repository path or credential-free Git URL.

ref.description: Source branch, tag, or commit to resolve.

expectedSourceSha.description: Full immutable source SHA approved during analysis.

destination.description: Safe, non-reserved workspace-relative destination; defaults to apps/<name>.

history.description: Explicit history strategy required for execution.

execute.description: Request mutation after every execution gate passes.

allowHistoryLoss.description: Explicitly acknowledge history loss for squash imports.
